svg.title: The layers under a Python node
svg.desc: Five boxes stacked from top to bottom, joined by arrows going down. Tag 1: battery_publisher.py, your node. Tag 2: rclpy, Python client library. Tag 3: rcl, C library: rclpy and rclcpp. Tag 4: rmw_fastrtps_cpp, ROS middleware interface. Tag 5: Fast DDS, sends the messages on the network.

path.aria-label: sends the messages on the network
